symptoms.symptom: The oven door feels hotter than before, after the oven door glass has been removed for cleaning.

causes.label: The oven door glass is not inserted the right way round.
remedies: Check if the oven door glass is inserted the right way round (low-E symbol can be read).
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The oven door glass is not inserted the right way round."

symptoms.symptom: The oven door is not balanced.

causes.label: The inner door glass is missing or has not been inserted during reassembly.
remedies: Check if the inner door glass is present or has been inserted during reassembly.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The inner door glass is missing or has not been inserted during reassembly."

symptoms.symptom: The cookware produces a crackling noise.

causes.label: The cookware is made from different multilayered materials
remedies: Refer to the section on Cooking with Induction to learn more about suitable cookware. Page 18
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The cookware is made from different multilayered materials"

causes.label: You are using cookware of different sizes and different materials.
remedies: Refer to the section on Cooking with Induction to learn more about suitable cookware. Page 18
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "You are using cookware of different sizes and different materials."

symptoms.symptom: The cooktop SpeedBoost® function cannot be activated or turns off before 5 minutes have elapsed.

causes.label: The cooking zone is too hot.
remedies: Let the cooking zone cool down.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The cooking zone is too hot."

causes.label: The cooking zone has been operating continuously for an extended period of time without interaction. The automatic time limitation has been triggered.
remedies: You can set the cooking zone and continue to cook.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "The cooking zone has been operating continuously for an extended period of time without interaction. The automatic time limitation has been triggered."

causes.label: The power supply voltage is out of range.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "The power supply voltage is out of range."

causes.label: The cooking zone is unable to detect cookware.
remedies: Place cookware on the cooking zone within 30 seconds after setting a power
If cookware is present on the cooking zone, check if the cookware is suitable
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "The cooking zone is unable to detect cookware."

causes.label: The set power level can not be executed.
remedies: Turn the control knob to 0 and then set a power level again.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "The set power level can not be executed."

causes.label: The control knob has been pushed in for more than 30 seconds.
remedies: Make sure the control knob is released after setting the power level.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "The control knob has been pushed in for more than 30 seconds."
